requirements.name: GitHub repository
requirements.details: At least one GitHub repository per product, conforming to the TASC repository template and the GitHub policies it references.
requirements.applies: From the start of development, and for the life of the product

requirements.name: Website
requirements.details: Any website representing a GA4GH product or topic is served from a ga4gh.org subdomain. Standalone and third-party domains are not permitted.

requirements.name: Retired status shown
requirements.details: On retirement, the repository and website show the product's retired status.

requirements.name: Starter kit
requirements.details: Content that lets a user begin building their own implementation: minimal scaffolding that can be extended for downstream workflows or applications. A reference implementation built by the product development team may serve as the starter kit.
requirements.applies: At product approval, and maintained thereafter

requirements.name: Conformance suite
requirements.details: A defined set of tests derived from the specification and traceable to its requirements and behaviours, stating the version it covers and its scope, optional features and limitations, so that a pass has a bounded meaning.

requirements.name: Maturity model and versioning
requirements.details: Semantic versioning, with product features annotated Draft, Trial Use, Normative or Deprecated, and advancement following the stated criteria.

requirements.name: API pagination
requirements.details: New products offering pagination use page-based or token-based pagination, with the specified parameter names, unless agreed otherwise with TASC.
requirements.applies: For any new API offering pagination

requirements.name: Interoperability
requirements.details: Interoperability is exchange of data and subsequent use of it without custom integrations, across three layers: syntactic, semantic, and behavioural. Products are assessed and risk-tiered against this definition.

requirements.name: Service Info type
requirements.details: GA4GH API services register a service type identifier (group plus a kebab-case artifact matching the stated pattern) and expose it through the Service Info endpoint. Registration is by PR to the TASC repository.
requirements.applies: Submitted early in the approval cycle; retrospective registration possible for approved products

requirements.name: GA4GH namespace prefix
requirements.details: Products minting `ga4gh:` identifiers register their type prefix with a name, documentation URI and, where applicable, a schema URI. Prefixes are uppercase, ideally 2 to 4 characters, name concrete types rather than parent classes, and map one-to-one to a schema type. Requests need the product owners' approval. Prefixes should not change between versions of a product.
requirements.applies: Prepared alongside the approval documentation, and before identifiers are published

requirements.name: Persistent URL
requirements.details: Products publishing JSON Schema register w3id.org redirect rules following the TASC pURL pattern, so that `$id` values resolve. Rules are added by PR to the ga4gh/w3id.org repository, with TASC reviewing and syncing upstream.

requirements.name: Originating group acronym
requirements.details: The group behind the product holds a registered acronym, which forms the `std_designator` in DOI metadata. Only acronyms in the registry may be used; a new group registers one before requesting a DOI.

requirements.name: DOIs
requirements.details: Approved products are assigned DOIs under the GA4GH prefix, covering at least the latest specification, the product landing page, and the documentation. DOIs are not minted for drafts, so this follows approval rather than gating it.

requirements.name: Citation file
requirements.details: A CITATION.cff file in the repository, carrying the registered DOI, so downstream users cite the product rather than an incidental paper.

requirements.name: Named product owner
requirements.details: At least one named product owner per product, set on approval, on a term-limited basis.
